admission.justification: Burst coalescing is the rail family guarantee burst leg; typed per-case proofs were withdrawn as extractor-unsupported. Quiet-window prose claims only per-window latest forwarding.

applicability: Selection bursts arriving while the control channel is not ready, in same-turn and successive-turn patterns.
conditions: A trailing settle window is armed per unavailable display only when a load readiness report is not being awaited.
Ready report, Retry, host return or superseding display preempts that window; a load wait holds the latest target until ready/pong or ping silence.
exclusions: Ready channel, which switches by immediate message.
Settled selections, which are never asked twice.

evidence: reviewer corrected 4-case oracle 4/4 (pair C, same C, ready retains frame + latest ar.open C, triple D; all zero-message-substitute) + full vitest population PASS + typecheck + eslint

statement: Selections while unavailable and not awaiting a load re-arm one trailing quiet window; its expiry forwards only the latest selection. During a load readiness wait selections are held until ready or pong and then go by message, unless open-agent is explicitly unsupported; only silence after that load's ping permits another fallback load.
